headline: Clean: on the fixed date (2025-11-14), the only personal card with an active points or cash sign-up bonus that a non-invited customer can get is EcoCard, because Silver's $500 bonus window closed on 2025-06-30.
solution_check: The sign-up bonus promos in the personal-card KB are Silver's $500 statement credit (silver_010, 'Accounts must be opened within: 2025-01-01 to 2025-06-30', expired), EcoCard's 2,000 bonus points (ecocard_009, 'runs from 2025-08-01 through 2025-12-15', active) and Diamond Elite's $5,000 credit (diamond_elite_009, invitation-only). The others are 0% APR or fee-waiver promos, not points or cash. Business cards are excluded by the customer. With get_current_time = 2025-11-14, EcoCard is the only eligible bonus, so the lowest-fee tie-break never comes into play. That matches gold[0] (EcoCard, Jordan Mitchell, 62000, false).
prior_note: Prior verdict was None and re-derivation agrees.
notes: The agent needs the current date to rule out Silver's expired bonus, and if it skips that check it would recommend Silver ($0 fee). The date comes from get_current_time, as policy_header guideline 4 directs. EcoCard's bonus is written as '$2,000 sustainability points' (a cosmetic dollar sign; the deciding fact is the promo window). Diamond Elite would waive its fee, but 'Membership is by invitation only'. In the earlier Opus runs 3 of 4 passed; trial 1 made no application.
